{{Top|leg}}
'''Thinskin briefs''' were a make of pants made from the material [[thinskin]] available by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] soldiers [[Phow Ji]] and [[Usu Cley]] wore thinskin briefs during a [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]] match they fought. The match took place near [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="MI:BS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> while both were stationed their during the [[Battle of Drongar]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thinskin briefs first appeared in [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]], the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="MI:BS" />

==Appearances==
*''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''
